_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Mixing up short e and a (bed / bad, pen / pan)

segments.text: Bed, bad, pen, pan. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Bed, bad, pen, pan.

native.caption: Apakah “bed” dan “bad” terdengar sama? Untuk “bed”, mulut terbuka sedang; untuk “bad”, buka mulut lebih lebar. Begitu juga “pen” dan “pan”. Perhatikan mulut Ama, lalu ulangi saat jeda. Latihan lebih lanjut ada di aplikasi Lexkite.

en.hook: Bed or bad? Watch the mouth!
en.caption: Do “bed” and “bad” sound the same? For “bed”, open your mouth a medium amount; for “bad”, open it wider. The same goes for “pen” and “pan”. Watch Ama’s mouth, then say each word in the pause. More practice is in the Lexkite app.
